newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 84 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 84 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated February 7 to commercial banks worth 84 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 73 billion pounds at 13 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth 11 billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
Last week the Bank sold 60-day CDs worth 36 billion pounds at 13 percent and 45-day CDs worth six billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
